# Citations and attribution

Collected 2026-09-14. Each of the 222 measurement/project files has its citation, exact source and license below and in its adjacent `.license` file. Original creator names and notices in the payload remain authoritative; a software citation is not presented as a measurement-specific publication.

The 12 RefXAS examples were obtained from RefXAS. Citation: [RefXAS paper](https://doi.org/10.1107/S1600577524006751).

Database references: [MDR XAFS Database](https://doi.org/10.48505/nims.1447), [CLS XAS Database](https://doi.org/10.20383/103.01329), [IXAS X-ray Absorption Data Library](https://xaslib.xrayabsorption.org/). Individual dataset citations follow.
